create_PositionalEncoding: create a PositionalEncoding module that applies sinusoidal positional encoding to a tensor with shape batch_size x seq_len x embed_dim
create_SpatioTemporalClsPositionalEncodi: create a SpatioTemporalClsPositionalEncoding module that adds a cls token and applies spatiotemporal encoding to a tensor
build_3d_sincos_pos_embed: build a 3D sine-cosine positional embedding tensor for video patches with grid_size, t_size, and optional cls token
build_2d_sincos_pos_embed: build a 2D sine-cosine positional embedding tensor for image patches with grid_size and optional cls token
create_1d_sincos_pos_embed_from_grid: create a 1D sine-cosine positional embedding from a numpy array of positions with a given embed_dim
